f83fe81e1d68c8d8.description: About the Role Sameer Al-Marzouki Engineering Consultants is seeking a Showroom Manager Automotive Protection & Care to oversee the daily operations of a showroom and workshop specializing in automotive protection and care services. This full-time position is based in Makkah and Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, and requires a professional with significant experience in the automotive care industry. Role Overview The Showroom Manager will be responsible for supervising the daily operations of a facility focused on paint protection film (PPF), window tinting, nano ceramic applications, and luxury car detailing. This role involves managing technical teams, ensuring service quality, and driving sales performance. Key Responsibilities Manage daily operations, organize work schedules, and supervise the team of technicians. Inspect vehicles and ensure the quality of work before delivery to clients. Manage inventory and monitor material consumption. Receive clients, prepare price quotations, and achieve sales targets. Handle customer complaints and warranty claims. Coordinate with agents and partners regarding vehicle reception and delivery. Prepare daily and monthly reports on sales and operational performance. Qualifications and Requirements Minimum of 5 years of experience in automotive care or paint protection, with at least 2 years in team management. Practical knowledge of paint protection film (PPF), window tinting, and nano ceramic applications. Strong communication and customer service skills. Proficiency in Arabic and a good command of English. Good organizational skills and proficiency in using Excel or Point of Sale (POS) systems. Work Location This role is based in the Makkah region, specifically covering operations in Jeddah and Makkah. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

f85172770245c428.description: About the Role Carrier is seeking an After Market Country Division Manager to lead and expand its Aftermarket business in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position, based in Riyadh, involves full responsibility for the division's Profit and Loss (P&L) performance. The role focuses on overseeing the complete aftermarket portfolio, including Service Modernization, Service Repair, Service Agreements, Parts, and Digital Service offerings, while leading both Sales and Operations teams to achieve sustainable business growth. Key Responsibilities Manage the Aftermarket Division's P&L, covering revenue, profitability, costs, margins, and cash flow. Develop and implement the country's aftermarket strategy in line with regional and global objectives to achieve profitable growth across all service lines. Lead the Service Modernization, Service Repair, Service Agreements, and Parts businesses, defining portfolio strategies, pricing models, and customer value propositions. Guide service sales and operational teams to meet business targets, develop effective go-to-market strategies, and enhance customer relationships and service contract penetration. Formulate and execute the Parts go-to-market strategy in collaboration with dealers, focusing on inventory planning, parts availability, inventory turns, and dealer performance. Drive digital service transformation and the development of new digital offerings, promoting the adoption of predictive maintenance, remote monitoring, and digital solutions. Identify new business opportunities, strengthen strategic customer partnerships, and increase market share across the aftermarket portfolio. Build, lead, and develop high-performing Sales, Operations, Service, and Parts teams, strengthening organizational capabilities and fostering a performance-driven culture. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering, with a preference for Mechanical Engineering. Over 15 years of relevant experience in Service, Aftermarket, or Industrial Operations. Demonstrated experience in full P&L management and leadership of service sales and operations. Strong commercial and operational experience, including service portfolio management, profitability, and parts business management. Proven experience in developing and executing business strategies and driving profitable growth. Experience in managing dealer networks and cultivating strong customer relationships. Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including building and developing high-performing teams. Work Environment This role is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring leadership of diverse teams across sales, operations, and service functions within Carrier's aftermarket division.

f8cbc78df1cce4b5.description: About AECOM AECOM is an infrastructure consulting firm focused on improving commutes, maintaining essential services, and transforming urban landscapes. The company partners with clients to address complex challenges and deliver projects that create a positive and tangible impact globally. With a team of over 50,000 professionals, AECOM is committed to a secure and trustworthy recruitment process, requiring all newly hired employees to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location. The Role: Façade Engineer - Design AECOM is seeking a Façade Engineer - Design to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves designing, developing, and optimizing building façade systems to meet both aesthetic and performance requirements. The engineer will collaborate with architects, structural engineers, and project teams to deliver high-quality façade solutions that comply with local and international building standards, while also addressing regional environmental challenges. Key Responsibilities Design and develop façade systems, including curtain walls, cladding, and glazing solutions, using advanced CAD and BIM software. Conduct detailed technical analysis of façade performance, covering thermal, acoustic, and structural considerations. Prepare comprehensive technical drawings, specifications, and documentation for construction and manufacturing. Evaluate and select appropriate materials and systems based on project requirements, climate conditions, and sustainability objectives. Ensure all designs comply with Saudi Arabian building codes, regulations, and international standards. Collaborate with architects and structural engineers to integrate façade systems with overall building design and structural elements. Analyze building envelope performance and recommend solutions for energy efficiency and moisture management. Prepare detailed cost estimates and material specifications for façade systems. Participate in design reviews, presentations, and client meetings to communicate technical solutions. Troubleshoot design challenges and develop innovative solutions for complex façade engineering problems. Maintain organized project documentation and ensure quality control throughout the design process. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in façade engineering design. Proficiency in advanced CAD and BIM software for façade system design. Strong understanding of thermal, acoustic, and structural considerations in façade performance. Knowledge of Saudi Arabian building codes, regulations, and relevant international standards. Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary project teams. Detail-oriented approach to design and documentation. Work Environment and Culture AECOM offers a workplace built on respect, collaboration, and community, providing resources for professional growth and career ambitions. Employees work on projects that impact local communities and global initiatives, supported by cutting-edge technology and a network of experts. The company provides award-winning training and development programs to enhance technical expertise and leadership skills. AECOM is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to fostering an inclusive environment. Benefits AECOM offers comprehensive benefits tailored to employee needs, which may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, an employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, a retirement savings plan, and an employee stock purchase plan, depending on employment status.

f879df5f3b7eecc4.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع نعمة الخير للمعجنات والشكولاته عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وتسوية الحسابات، وضمان دقة سجلات المبيعات. الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية عد وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية وردية العمل، مع التأكد من توفر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقة الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات المناسبة للعملاء. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات اللازمة عند الاقتضاء. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات أو تسويتها وفقاً للإجراءات المتبعة. التعامل مع العملاء بأسلوب مهني وودي، وتلبية رغباتهم فيما يتعلق بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في دور مماثل كموظف صندوق محاسبة أو أمين صندوق. القدرة على التعامل مع المبالغ النقدية بدقة وسرعة. مهارات جيدة في استخدام آلات تسجيل النقود وأنظمة نقاط البيع. القدرة على تسوية الحسابات والإبلاغ عن أي فروقات. المهارات الشخصية مهارات تواصل ممتازة ولباقة في التعامل مع العملاء. دقة عالية واهتمام بالتفاصيل في المهام المالية. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق وفي بيئة عمل سريعة الوتيرة. المرونة في التعامل مع متطلبات العمل المختلفة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة جدة بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصنع نعمة الخير للمعجنات والشكولاته، وتتطلب الالتزام بمواعيد العمل المحددة لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة على تقديم طلباتهم.

f8a2d4ddbdb317cf.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking a Fire Fighting & Plumbing Engineer. This regular position involves the design review, site supervision, inspection, testing, commissioning, and delivery of fire protection and plumbing systems across various building and infrastructure projects. The role ensures that all Fire Fighting and Plumbing works comply with project specifications, approved drawings, local authority regulations, international standards, and health and safety requirements. Key Responsibilities Provide technical expertise throughout the project lifecycle, coordinating with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, consultants, and stakeholders. Ensure the successful delivery of high-quality and compliant mechanical systems, including fire suppression networks, fire pumps, sprinkler systems, hydrant systems, water supply networks, drainage systems, sewage treatment interfaces, and plumbing infrastructure. Review Fire Fighting and Plumbing designs, calculations, specifications, and drawings for compliance with project requirements and applicable standards. Coordinate with architects, structural engineers, MEP engineers, and utility providers to ensure seamless integration of mechanical systems. Review shop drawings, technical submittals, material approvals, and method statements. Identify design conflicts and provide practical engineering solutions. Support value engineering initiatives and design optimization efforts. Project Execution and Compliance Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, authorities, and project stakeholders. Participate in technical meetings, progress reviews, and coordination workshops. Respond to RFIs and site technical queries. Provide engineering recommendations and technical support during project execution. Assist project management teams in resolving technical and construction-related issues. Review and maintain project documentation, including inspection records, technical reports, as-built drawings, and testing records. Ensure compliance with project specifications, local authority requirements, and regulatory approvals. Monitor implementation of quality assurance and quality control procedures. Support authority inspections and approval processes. Assist in preparation of final handover documentation. Site Supervision and Quality Assurance Inspect installation works related to fire protection and plumbing systems to ensure compliance with approved designs and specifications. Monitor contractor performance and construction progress. Verify material installations and workmanship quality. Conduct routine site inspections and prepare inspection reports and non-conformance reports where required. Ensure construction activities meet project quality standards and schedule requirements. Health, Safety, and Continuous Improvement Promote and enforce compliance with project HSE requirements. Monitor safe installation and testing practices on site. Ensure adherence to quality management systems and project procedures. Support continuous improvement initiatives and best engineering practices. Maintain AtkinsRéalis standards for safety, quality, and technical excellence.

f8b6ea7bc14fccdc.company_name: شركة الخدمات الاستشارية السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية
f8b6ea7bc14fccdc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخدمات الاستشارية السعودية للاستشارات الهندسية عن رسام هندسي مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد المخططات الهندسية للطرق والتقاطعات والخدمات المرتبطة بها، وذلك باستخدام برامج AutoCAD وCivil 3D. يعمل الرسام الهندسي بالتنسيق المباشر مع مهندسي الطرق لضمان تحويل التصاميم والمسوحات الميدانية إلى مخططات دقيقة تتوافق مع المواصفات والكودات المعتمدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد مخططات الطرق والتقاطعات، بما في ذلك المساقط الأفقية والقطاعات الطولية والعرضية، وتفاصيل الأرصفة والجزر والأكتاف، وتصريف مياه الأمطار، والعلامات واللوحات المرورية باستخدام AutoCAD وCivil 3D. تحويل المسوحات الميدانية والرسومات الأولية إلى مخططات رقمية دقيقة. تنسيق مخططات الطرق مع الخدمات والمرافق الأخرى وتحديد أي تعارضات محتملة. إعداد مخططات ما بعد التنفيذ (As-Built). تعديل المخططات بناءً على ملاحظات المهندسين والاستشاريين والعملاء. استخراج الكميات الأولية للأعمال الترابية والسفلتة عند الحاجة. الالتزام بمعايير ومتطلبات وزارة النقل والبلديات. تنظيم وأرشفة الملفات الهندسية وفقًا لنظام إدارة الوثائق المعتمد. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الرسم الهندسي المدني، وتحديداً في مشاريع الطرق. إتقان استخدام برامج الرسم الهندسي مثل AutoCAD وCivil 3D. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الهندسية والمسوحات الميدانية. معرفة جيدة بمواصفات وكودات تصميم الطرق المعتمدة. مهارات تواصل وتنسيق فعالة مع فريق العمل والمهندسين. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل الرسام الهندسي ضمن فريق متخصص، وستتضمن مهامه التنسيق المستمر مع مهندسي الطرق لضمان دقة المخططات وتوافقها مع متطلبات المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة.

f8c6c9ecd37c99ef.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة سوفيتيل جبل عمر عن مأمور سنترال للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على استقبال طلبات العملاء وتسجيلها بدقة في النظام، وتوجيهها إلى الأقسام المعنية، ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان تلبية احتياجات العملاء في الوقت المحدد، مع الالتزام بمعايير الخدمة والجودة المعتمدة في الفندق. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال طلبات العملاء وتسجيلها بدقة وفقًا للإجراءات المعتمدة في الفندق. إدخال الطلبات وتحديث بياناتها بانتظام في النظام المخصص ومتابعة حالتها. توجيه الطلبات إلى الأقسام المعنية والتنسيق معها لضمان تنفيذها بفعالية. متابعة جميع الطلبات والتأكد من إنجازها في الأوقات المحددة. الرد على استفسارات العملاء ومعالجة الملاحظات المتعلقة بالطلبات باحترافية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو أدوار مماثلة. القدرة على استخدام أنظمة تسجيل الطلبات وتحديث البيانات. مهارات تواصل ممتازة وقدرة على التعامل مع العملاء بفعالية. الالتزام بمعايير الخدمة والجودة المعتمدة. بيئة العمل يعمل مأمور السنترال ضمن فريق في فندق سوفيتيل جبل عمر بمدينة مكة المكرمة. تتطلب الوظيفة التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل لضمان تقديم خدمة مستمرة وعالية الجودة للعملاء. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل في قطاع الضيافة بمدينة مكة المكرمة. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة.

f804898061da453e.description: About the Role Dussmann Ajlan & Bros is seeking a Facilities Management Consultant to join their team. This full-time position is based in Jeddah and Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and involves providing expert guidance and management for facilities services to clients and service providers. Key Responsibilities Provide technical guidance to clients and FM service providers for hard and soft services, ensuring alignment with industry best practices and standards such as SFG20, NFPA, SBC, ASHRAE, CIBSE, and BICSc. Manage and support the project team, including FMMA engineers, QHSE specialists, soft service specialists, and document control personnel. Identify service delivery gaps of FM service providers and develop improvement plans to meet client expectations. Manage facility management service providers on behalf of clients, encompassing performance evaluations, technical guidance, gap analysis, O&M monitoring, training, and cost control. Lead detailed asset condition surveys to estimate replacement costs and develop tender documents for asset replacement. Support clients during the tender stage, including document review, installation inspections, T&C witnessing, and asset handover. Develop and support the project team in creating facility management policies, procedures, and other ad hoc documents for clients. Evaluate technical and commercial documents from FM service providers and clients. Manage VVIP sites and maintain standard facilities management operations and maintenance. Develop and implement facility management strategies that align with client objectives and industry best practices. Build and maintain strong client relationships, understanding their needs and delivering tailored solutions. Conduct training sessions for clients and FM service providers' staff on best practices and standards in facility management. Assist soft service specialists in implementing best practices and standards for pest control, landscaping, and housekeeping. Ensure service providers adhere to contractual clauses and statutory requirements, providing recommendations as needed. Conduct comprehensive assessments of existing facilities and systems. Develop and implement safety protocols and emergency response plans. Identify opportunities for energy savings and sustainability improvements. Prepare reports and presentations for stakeholders. Provide expert advice to clients regarding facility operations and management. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering. A business administration degree is advantageous. Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CFM, FMP, PMP, or similar. Experience: A minimum of 10 years of experience in facility management within the Middle East, with at least 3 years in facility management consultancy or an FMMA lead role. Client Management: Proven experience managing VVIP clients. Required Skills Technical expertise in mechanical, electrical, plumbing, civil, and soft services. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, requiring on-site presence and interaction with clients and service providers across various locations in Saudi Arabia.

f836c3bb1b89f336.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سيرة النخبة للتجارة عن محضر أطعمة باردة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد وتقديم المشروبات الباردة والساخنة وفقاً لمعايير الجودة المعتمدة، مع ضمان تجربة مميزة للعملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتحضير القهوة والمشروبات الساخنة والباردة بناءً على الوصفات ومعايير الجودة المعتمدة. تشغيل وصيانة معدات تحضير القهوة، بما في ذلك آلة الإسبريسو ومطحنة القهوة، وضبط الكميات بدقة. استقبال طلبات العملاء وتجهيزها وتقديمها بأسلوب مهني ولبق وفي الوقت المناسب. المحافظة على جودة المشروبات ومظهرها، والتعامل مع ملاحظات العملاء وإبلاغ المسؤول عند الضرورة. تنظيف وتعقيم معدات وأدوات التحضير، وضمان نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل بشكل مستمر. متابعة توفر المواد الخام والمستلزمات مثل القهوة والحليب والأكواب، وإبلاغ المسؤول عند قرب نفادها. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة الشخصية واشتراطات سلامة الغذاء، والتعاون مع فريق العمل لضمان سرعة وجودة الخدمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال تحضير المشروبات أو دور مماثل. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة الغذائية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

f8b0894b4102f394.description: About MEMF Electrical Industries Co. MEMF Electrical Industries Co., the industrial arm of KFB Holding Group, supports Saudi Arabia’s power infrastructure by providing locally engineered and high-quality electrical products. The company operates advanced manufacturing facilities in Riyadh, producing a range of solutions for utility and industrial customers. These products include smart energy meters, circuit breakers (MCB / MCCB / ACB), LV & MV instrument transformers, LV & MV switchgear solutions (up to 36 kV), distribution & power transformers (up to 10 MVA), and FRP meter boxes & feeder pillars. All products are internationally type-tested and supported by engineering expertise and certified quality systems (ISO 9001 & ISO 45001). The Role of Human Resources Business Partner MEMF Electrical Industries Co. is seeking a Human Resources Business Partner to join its team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role involves strategic HR guidance and operational support, aligning HR initiatives with business objectives. The position requires 7-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Partner with senior management and operational leaders to align HR strategies with business objectives. Develop and implement workforce planning strategies to support oil and gas operations and business requirements. Provide strategic HR guidance on organizational development, talent management, and succession planning. Oversee performance management processes and support leadership in enhancing employee productivity. Manage employee relations, conflict resolution, disciplinary matters, and grievance procedures. Support recruitment, retention, and workforce mobilization initiatives for technical, engineering, and operational roles. Drive employee engagement, leadership development, and talent retention initiatives. Analyze HR metrics and workforce trends to support data-driven decision-making. Ensure compliance with Saudi Labor Law, company policies, and applicable industry regulations. Support organizational change initiatives and collaborate with HR teams to deliver effective HR solutions. Required Experience Candidates should possess 7-10 years of experience in a relevant Human Resources role. What We Offer A competitive salary package commensurate with qualifications and experience. Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. A collaborative and dynamic working environment. f8fc3dd88b9f0cb2.description: Job Title: Chief Specialist, Accelerating Discovery to Development (E&RD Business Partner) Reporting To: VP Technology Enablement Business Unit / Function: Technology & Innovation Department: Technology Enablement Grade: M13 Why This Role Matters The Chief Specialist, Accelerating Discovery to Development transforms how Ma aden applies technology to mineral exploration, accelerating the journey from exploration insight to scientifically validated, decision-ready evidence. The role connects frontier technologies in automation, advanced sensing, Data & AI, subsurface analytics, and laboratory science to create faster, more reliable and scalable exploration capabilities. As an enterprise technical authority, the role shapes how emerging technologies are selected, validated and applied across the exploration lifecycle. It brings together field acquisition, laboratory validation and digital intelligence to shorten learning cycles, improve confidence in exploration findings, reduce avoidable rework and strengthen the technical basis for investment and portfolio decisions. The role creates additional value by translating proven approaches from Oil & Gas, space exploration, OEMs, academia and research into practical mineral exploration applications. Its accountability is how exploration technology is applied and validated , rather than ownership of exploration outcomes, laboratories, digital platforms or approval decisions. What You Will Deliver Exploration Technology Leadership Shape the enterprise exploration technology roadmap to accelerate discovery and validation through automation, advanced sensing, AI-enabled targeting and intelligent drilling. Translate emerging technologies into deployable exploration capabilities , selecting solutions based on scientific validity, technology readiness, field applicability and potential business value. Build Ma aden s technical advantage by identifying and adapting relevant technologies and practices from Oil & Gas subsurface science, space exploration, OEMs, academia and research institutions. Data, AI & Subsurface Intelligence Advance AI-enabled exploration by integrating geological, geophysical, geochemical and remote-sensing information to strengthen subsurface interpretation, target ranking and uncertainty management. Apply advanced analytics , including predictive modelling, deep learning, physics-informed AI and probabilistic approaches, to increase the speed and confidence of exploration insights. Establish confidence-based decision metrics that make uncertainty, reproducibility and learning rate visible alongside conventional exploration measures. Accelerated Field-to-Lab Validation Transform the field-to-lab validation cycle by connecting sensing, drilling and sampling with high-throughput analytical methods, automated core analysis and digital sample traceability. Accelerate independent and reproducible validation of exploration findings , reducing analytical turnaround, rework and delays between initial observation and decision-ready evidence. Strengthen approval readiness by establishing fit-for-purpose certified analytical technologies, traceable data and scientifically defensible methods that enable efficient technical review, external reporting and portfolio decisions. Integrated Exploration Operating Model Design scalable field-lab-digital workflows that connect field acquisition, laboratory analysis and AI-enabled interpretation into a coherent exploration technology model. Enable greater exploration productivity through automation, digital twins, sensor fusion, autonomous or remote technologies and AI-assisted decision workflows. Align laboratory capacity, automation and digital capability with exploration ambition , enabling technology solutions to scale as exploration activity evolves. Technology Innovation & Value Realization Evaluate frontier technologies for practical exploration value , balancing scientific robustness, technology readiness, deployment constraints, cost, risk and scalability. Accelerate transfer of proven cross-industry innovation into mineral exploration, particularly in autonomous systems, subsurface analytics, remote sensing and extreme-environment instrumentation. Demonstrate measurable technology value through shorter learning and validation cycles, lower re-testing and re-sampling, improved target confidence and more efficient exploration workflows. What Success Looks Like Shorter field-to-validated-result cycle time , enabling exploration evidence to reach technical and portfolio decisions faster. Reduced laboratory turnaround time and avoidable re-analysis , with stronger first-time quality, traceability and reproducibility of critical results. Higher confidence in drill-ready targets , supported by integrated data, explicit uncertainty measures and scientifically defensible validation. Faster progression from exploration concept to drill-ready target through effective application of automation, AI and advanced sensing technologies. Improved exploration efficiency , demonstrated through reduced cost, re-sampling, re-testing and decision latency attributable to technology-enabled workflows. Successful adoption and scaling of high-value technologies , including AI-enabled exploration and relevant cross-industry innovations. Desired Candidate Profile Advanced degree in Geoscience, Geophysics, Mining Engineering or a related discipline; MSc or PhD preferred. Experience 20+ years of relevant experience in mineral exploration, subsurface science or adjacent Oil & Gas exploration domains. Demonstrated experience applying Data & AI, automation, advanced sensing or subsurface analytics in exploration or comparable technical environments. Experience with advanced analytical laboratories, mineral characterization, high-throughput testing, certified analytical methods or regulatory acceptance processes . Experience applying AI-enabled QA/QC, anomaly detection, confidence estimation or uncertainty analysis , combined with strong understanding of field exploration constraints. Skills That Matter Mineral exploration technology and subsurface science Advanced sensing, drilling and field technologies Data, AI and predictive subsurface analytics Laboratory analytics and mineral characterization Scientific validation, QA/QC and uncertainty quantification Technology assessment, qualification and scaling Exploration workflow optimization and value realization Cross-industry technology transfer Executive-level technical advisory and stakeholder influence Cross-disciplinary collaboration across geoscience, digital, engineering, R&D, OEMs and academia

f805d5eb80db8671.description: About the Role Rawafid Alhadara is seeking an ERP & Projects Cost Controller to join its finance team in Jeddah, Makkah Province. f82f3e02c516f22d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات عن مهندس إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية وضع وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع المتكاملة، وإدارة التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الجداول الزمنية وإدارة التكاليف والموارد. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان سير المشاريع بكفاءة وفعالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع وتنفيذ خطة متكاملة للمشروع، والتحكم في التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة من حيث البنود والأزمنة، مع التعرف على الجوانب الفنية المحددة لتنفيذ العمل. تقدير الأوقات والمواعيد النهائية للمشروع، وإعداد الجداول الزمنية باستخدام البرامج والتطبيقات المتخصصة، وتحديد المهام المجدولة وفترات تنفيذها والموارد المتاحة لكل منها. إدارة التكلفة والموارد المطلوبة لإنجاز المشروع، بما في ذلك تخطيط وإدارة الموارد البشرية والمادية والمعدات والتقنيين، وتقدير التكلفة المتوقعة بالتعاون مع مهندسي التكاليف والمهندسين المعنيين بالتنفيذ، ومتابعة الإنفاق. إعداد وتطبيق خطة علاقات مع جميع الأطراف ذات الصلة بالمشروع، وتوفير أساس لتوزيع المعلومات ونشر حالة مراحل المشروع. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع. القدرة على وضع خطط مشاريع متكاملة والتحكم في التغييرات. إتقان استخدام برامج وتطبيقات إعداد الجداول الزمنية. مهارات قوية في إدارة التكاليف والموارد. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق الفنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في قطاع المقاولات، مما يتطلب التعاون الفعال مع مختلف الأقسام والأطراف المعنية بالمشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المؤهلين وذوي الخبرة للتقدم لهذا الدور في مجموعة بن جارالله للمقاولات.

f8ad103e67a56210.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة وجد الحياة للتجارة عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في الخرج. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وصيانة المعدات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المهندس الكهربائي مسؤولية مجموعة من المهام الهندسية والفنية لضمان كفاءة وسلامة الأنظمة الكهربائية. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية في المشاريع الصناعية، بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية، بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير العمل وإعداد التقارير يساهم شاغل الوظيفة في تحسين الأداء التشغيلي من خلال تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. كما يقوم بإعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة التي توثق نتائج الدراسات والتحاليل، ويعرضها ويناقشها مع الأطراف المعنية. المؤهلات والخبرة درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بأنظمة النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال وإجراء الصيانة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتشخيص الأعطال وحل المشكلات. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لعرض ومناقشة النتائج. القدرة على مواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الخرج، الرياض. يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تنفيذ وصيانة المشاريع الكهربائية المختلفة.

f8cae426c3f9e5ed.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سيشور للصناعة عن كاتب مالي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم في العمليات المالية الأساسية، بما في ذلك جمع البيانات المالية، وإجراء الحسابات، وعرض النتائج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات المالية والتحقق من صحتها، ثم إدخالها في السجلات اليدوية أو أنظمة البيانات المخصصة. تنفيذ العمليات الحسابية البسيطة وتسجيلها، وتحليل البيانات المالية مثل المتوسطات والنسب المئوية والمعدلات. حفظ سجلات دقيقة للمعاملات المالية، والاحتفاظ بالوثائق الداعمة للرجوع إليها عند الحاجة. إعداد التقارير المالية، ومراجعة صيغها لضمان الدقة، وطباعة هذه التقارير وتوزيعها. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعمول بها في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع البيانات المالية بدقة واهتمام بالتفاصيل. مهارات جيدة في استخدام برامج الحاسوب الأساسية. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة سيشور للصناعة.

f8135b2c48d73935.description: Rawafid is seeking a detail-oriented Governance & Prequalification Officer who will be responsible for managing and maintaining all corporate registration and compliance documentation for a group of five companies or more, ensuring continuous validity and compliance with Saudi Arabian laws and regulations. The role also involves leading and maintaining vendor registration and prequalification processes with both public (government) and private sector clients, and actively researching business opportunities that align with each company’s annual strategy and market focus. Responsibilities Maintain, update, and organize all company incorporation and registration documents for all group entities. Ensure that all licenses, certificates, and registrations are valid, renewed on time, and in compliance with Saudi law. Prepare and submit renewal or amendment requests to relevant authorities as needed. Maintain digital archives of all official corporate documents. Coordinate with legal advisors, auditors, and government relations officers (Mudad, Qiwa, MOC, ZATCA, GOSI, Chamber of Commerce, etc.) to ensure full corporate compliance. Lead and coordinate the prequalification and vendor registration process for all five companies with major government and semi-government platforms (e.g., Etimad, Aramco, SEC, SWCC, NEOM, PIF companies ) and private clients. Prepare and update company profiles, registration forms, and required supporting documents (financials, licenses, references, safety records, etc.). Maintain a master tracking sheet for all vendor registrations and their renewal dates. Follow up with clients and procurement departments to ensure successful registration and activation. Develop and standardize templates for vendor registration and compliance submissions across all companies. Continuously monitor tender platforms, procurement portals, and business news for opportunities relevant to each company’s activities. Track opportunities through Etimad, Monsha’at, Aramco IKTVA, PIF projects, and major private developers. Prepare weekly and monthly reports summarizing potential tenders or partnership opportunities in line with each company’s strategic business focus. Coordinate internally with business development and management teams to prioritize and pursue qualified leads. Maintain an updated calendar of relevant events, exhibitions, and prequalification windows. Prepare periodic compliance and registration status reports for management review. Support cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance, Business Development) with up-to-date corporate data. Suggest process improvements for document management and vendor registration workflows. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Law, or a related field. Fresh Graduate- 3 years of experience in governance, compliance, or procurement in the construction industry. Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and industry standards relevant to construction. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Detail-oriented with strong organization skills. Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams. Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word. Experience with document management systems and compliance software. Knowledge of ISO or other relevant certifications is a plus.

f8f0273ff686c1e6.description: About the job : Intertek is a global leader in Testing, Inspection and Certification, trusted worldwide to ensure quality, safety and compliance. Through our new Relocation Program , we are seeking experienced Aramco Inspectors with strong expertise in vendor inspections across mechanical and electrical disciplines. This program is designed to offer a long-term career path in our office in France, supported by relocation assistance (visa and work permit sponsorship in single status) , and the opportunity to contribute to high-profile projects under Aramco standards. Candidate must be willing to relocate to our office in Lyon, France. Role Overview : We are looking for Aramco-Approved Vendor Inspectors who will perform vendor inspections of equipment, components and fabrication processes at supplier facilities. The role ensures that all activities comply with Aramco specifications, international codes, and client requirements. This is a unique opportunity for inspectors committed to quality and safety who want to build a lasting career in Europe with Intertek. Minimum Requirements : Bachelor’s/Diploma degree in Mechanical / Metallurgical / Welding / Materials / Electricals / Instrumentation engineering discipline (or equivalent) Minimum 5-10+ years in vendor inspections in oil & gas / petrochemical / power / heavy fabrication environment; prior exposure to Saudi Aramco projects is strongly preferred Must hold an Aramco “approved vendor inspector / VID” status with valid QM codes Having Aramco Approvals QM26 (mandatory), QM30 (mandatory), QM27, QM31. Certifications : Pass Aramco CBT (Competency Based Test) - NDT certification (Level II / III) in relevant methods (PT, MT, UT, RT) - Welding Inspector Certification (e.g. CSWIP / AWS / equivalent) - API/ASME / code qualifications depending on department (e.g. API 650, API 620, ASME Section V / IX) Technical Knowledge : Strong knowledge of welding, metallurgy, heat treatment, materials testing, codes & standards (ASME, API, AWS, ASTM), inspection methods, non-destructive testing techniques, fabrication processes, etc. What We Offer : Permanent employment contract with Intertek France. Full visa and work permit sponsorship (in single status). Relocation assistance Career growth opportunities within a global leader in TIC. The chance to work on major vendor inspection projects under Aramco standards in Europe

f8ac6836b8531552.description: Eram Talent is looking for a qualified QA/QC Engineer specializing in Electrical systems to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that electrical projects meet quality standards and comply with regulatory requirements. As a QA/QC Engineer, you will play a vital role in the quality assurance process, conducting inspections, reviews, and tests on electrical installations and equipment. An experienced Electrical Engineer with a strong background in design reviews, material selection and installation, site supervision, and quality inspections for the electrical components of construction works. This role demands a high level of expertise in the design, execution, testing, and commissioning of complex electrical systems. The ideal candidate will ensure stringent adherence to design criteria, codes, and industry standards at every stage of the project life cycle. Responsibilities: Perform quality control inspections and audits on electrical systems, installations, and equipment to ensure compliance with specifications and standards. Develop and implement quality assurance procedures and protocols related to electrical works. Review and interpret electrical drawings, specifications, and project documents. Conduct inspections and testing of electrical installations, materials, and equipment to ensure compliance with project and industry standards. Monitor and verify the implementation of electrical QA/QC procedures on-site. Review design documents and provide feedback to ensure constructability and compliance with codes and standards. Prepare and maintain inspection test plans (ITP), checklists, and quality records. Coordinate with construction, design, and procurement teams to resolve quality-related issues. Ensure that all electrical work adheres to international standards (e.g., IEC, IEEE, NEC). Participate in audits, material inspections, and commissioning activities. Report non-conformances and ensure corrective actions are implemented effectively. Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in QA/QC for electrical systems in industrial or construction environments. Strong background in design reviews, material selection and installation, site supervision, and quality inspections for the electrical components of construction works. Strong knowledge of the Saudi Building Code (SBC), and international codes such as IBC, NFPA 70, IEC, IEEE. Experience with design review, installation supervision, and commissioning activities. Familiar with QA/QC documentation, ITPs, NCRs, and method statements. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Proficient in quality control methodologies and tools. Effective communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment. Relevant certifications in QA/QC or electrical engineering are preferred. Salary is not a constraint ,company is looking for right candidate .

f8e9c4ab488371e8.description: Eram Talent is seeking a Drilling Foreman to join our Unconventional Resources Drilling Department (URDD). Candidate primary role will be to supervise field operations of land Drilling and Workover rigs, engaged in carrying programmed work on deep or otherwise critical wells. Supervises and oversees the operations of a contract rig performing drilling or remedial work on wells ranging from 18,000 - 23,000 feet. Incumbent will ensure that the contractor performs the work in a safe and acceptable manner, and that the contractor meets all the obligations of his contract. Coordinates deliveries of well materials and equipment and ensures it is available when the rig is ready for it. Drilling Rig Foreman administers the contracts on sight and serves as the primary liaison between the company and the contractor. Responsibilities Ensure all rig personnel and service providers are complaining with Saudi Aramco safety standards and requirement. Supervises and oversees all operations performed on wells. Makes recommendations on alternative methods or equipment when unusual situations are encountered. Coordinates deliveries of materials to the well to ensure it is available when required. Ensures that contractor meets all requirements of his contract. Works with Drilling and Workover engineers to see that modern drilling practices are followed. Approves contractor daily tour report. Ensures that contractor rig and equipment are properly maintained to avoid downtime. Performs other miscellaneous duties as directed by Supt. Ensures that Saudi Aramco Blowout Prevention Standards are met in all respects including equipment configuration, testing and crew response. Assures that rig and personnel comply with Saudi Aramco established safety standards and procedures. Minimum of 7 years of experience working in drilling and workover operations including adequate supervisory experience on a drilling or workover rig. Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field is preferred; Extensive knowledge of drilling equipment, techniques, and safety measures; Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills; Ability to work in high-pressure environments and make quick decisions; Willingness to work in remote locations and harsh weather conditions.
